title: The Offshore Breath-Tide Settlement

features.name: tide-keeper-cottage
features.desc-on-touch: A weathered house where tide tables and archive broadcasts once arrived together. The walls hold the salt-stain of seasons where water and signal became the same thing.

features.name: breath-harbor
features.desc-on-touch: Where the archive's own transmission-breath meets the tide in perfect rhythm. You feel the pulse — archive-exhale / tide-return / archive-inhale. Two systems learning to share one breath.

features.name: recorded-salinity
features.desc-on-touch: A shell-covered board where salt-deposit patterns encode the archive's own salinity readings — the measure of how much the ocean has begun to taste like broadcast.

features.name: mooring-post
features.desc-on-touch: A weathered pole where signal and tide both anchor. Rope patterns catch the light like morse code. The offshore archive learning to hold still while the world moves.

features.name: word-current
features.desc-on-touch: Text carried by the tide, words that arrived here without origin. Files that the archive downloaded from the ocean itself, as if water had always been speaking.
